modelDescription: The Retay ACE is a versatile semi-automatic shotgun designed for various shooting applications. Available in 12-gauge, 20-gauge, and 28-gauge configurations, it offers options for different preferences. The shotgun features Retay's Inertia Plus action system, ensuring reliable cycling and performance.
